medium: flat vector icon / infographic pictogram, no photorealism

canvas.background: solid white, no texture, no gradient background
canvas.layout: grid of numbered cards, consistent column width
card_structure: single-line plain-English caption (bottom, centered, gray-black text)

usage.outline_only_state: black or near-black stroke, white/transparent fill — represents 'unselected' or 'baseline' figures
usage.solid_fill_state: same purple hue at full saturation, no stroke needed — represents 'the group being called out'
usage.highlight_overlay: same purple hue at low opacity (~15-25%), soft rounded/organic blob or capsule shape, placed BEHIND the called-out figures like a highlighter-pen stroke, edges softly rounded not sharp-cornered

figure_proportions.head: simple circle, unfilled outline (never filled, even when body is solid), proportionally large relative to body
figure_proportions.torso: long, narrow, gently tapered rounded rectangle — reads as 'thin and light', not bulky
figure_proportions.arms: omitted or minimal — implied by torso silhouette only, no separate limb shapes
figure_proportions.legs_and_feet: critical signature trait: legs are very short and stubby relative to torso length — torso occupies most of the figure height, legs/feet compress into a small base, NOT naturalistic human proportions — closer to a paper-doll or bowling-pin silhouette than an anatomical figure
figure_proportions.stroke_weight: uniform thin line weight throughout, consistent across every icon in the set
figure_proportions.corner_style: soft rounded corners on every shape, no sharp angles

iconographic_symbol_library.emphasis_marker: small circle badge with checkmark or exclamation mark, placed above/beside a figure's head to tag a status (positive test, healthy, etc.)
iconographic_symbol_library.grouping_connector: thin black bracket/brace line connecting a subset of figures to a single downstream icon or outcome
iconographic_symbol_library.threshold_metaphor: a doorway/frame shape a figure walks through, representing a diagnostic cutoff or test threshold
iconographic_symbol_library.change_over_time: simple arrow between two icon groups to represent before/after or progression

composition_rules.figures_per_icon: 3-6, arranged in a single horizontal row unless the concept requires two rows (before/after)
composition_rules.called_out_subset: always visually distinguished by BOTH solid-purple fill AND the soft highlight-blob overlay together, never one without the other
composition_rules.consistency: identical figure silhouette reused across all icons in the set — only fill state and grouping change, never the base figure design itself

typography.title: bold, dark, sans-serif, sits above the icon
typography.caption: regular weight, muted dark gray, single sentence, plain language, sits below the icon

negative_constraints: no anatomical detail (no fingers, faces, clothing texture)
no outlines on the solid-fill purple figures
no secondary colors beyond the single purple hue and black/gray text
no photorealistic or 3D rendering of any kind
